肥鱼笔记 0.4.0，支持 Android 8.0 及以上。项目仍处于早期预览阶段。

- 全新界面：鲸鱼娘配色，卡片更圆润，浅色和深色都重新调过；空列表配贴纸，回答生成中显示跳动的小点，新建课次改为右下角按钮。
- 设置拆分：DeepSeek 密钥单独成页，只有这一页禁止截屏；设置首页顶部显示密钥状态和交流群（QQ 群 1079399140，可一键复制）。
- 可以单独关闭聊天或学习，至少保留一项；只留聊天时首页只剩公共聊天。关闭只隐藏入口，不删除数据。
- 公共聊天的助手换成软萌体贴的“鱼鱼”，称呼你为“用户酱”；事实和计算仍按准确优先回答。
- 内置提示词和未修改的“引导式讲解”模板随应用语言使用中文或英文；在“高级”里改过的提示词保持不变。

通过[独立下载页](https://feiyunote.cangming.fyi/feiyu/)或本页下方的 APK 覆盖安装，升级时保留现有课程、笔记、照片、设置和密钥。0.3.2 及以后的版本也可在设置的「关于与帮助」中检查更新。数据保存在本地，提问时所选内容会发送给 DeepSeek。

欢迎加入 QQ 交流群 1079399140，或[提出功能建议](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/issues/new?template=feature.yml)；贡献代码前请通过 Issue 确认范围，详见[贡献指南](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)。

Feiyu Notes 0.4.0 is an early preview for Android 8.0+.

- A new look: whale-girl colours, rounder cards, retuned light and dark themes, stickers on empty lists, typing dots while an answer is generated, and a floating button for new sessions.
- Settings split: the DeepSeek key has its own page, the only screen that blocks screenshots; the top of Settings shows the key status and the discussion group (QQ group 1079399140, one tap to copy).
- Chat or study can be turned off on its own (at least one stays on); with only chat on, the home screen is just the general chat. Turning one off hides it without deleting data.
- The general chat assistant is now "Yuyu", a soft and caring companion who calls you "User-chan"; facts and calculations still come first.
- Built-in prompts and the unedited "Guided explanation" template follow the app language (Chinese or English); prompts you edited under Advanced stay as they are.

Install over your current version from the [independent download page](https://feiyunote.cangming.fyi/feiyu/) or the APK below; courses, notes, photos, settings and your key are kept. From 0.3.2 on, you can also check for updates in Settings → About and help. Data stays on your device; selected content is sent to DeepSeek when you ask a question. See the [README](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/blob/main/README.en.md) and the [contribution guide](https://github.com/Yongzhaooo/FeiyuNote/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#english).
